values.text:
Hi there,

This month your apps get more to build on, and your assistant gets more done. Watch real user sessions, bring in a design, connect your data and teach your assistant new skills.

Here’s the rundown.

values.altText: A session recording with a play bar

values.text: Session recordings are here. Watch real sessions, see the exact moment someone gets stuck, and fix what you saw, not what you guessed.

values.altText: A design being brought into the app

values.text: That mock-up doesn’t have to stay a mock-up. Bring it in and it becomes a working app, ready to build on.
If your data lives in a warehouse, you can now build on it directly. Connect it once for the whole workspace.
Your assistant joins the group chat
Add your assistant to a group chat and it answers questions and runs tasks right in the thread, for everyone in it.
Skills add ready-made know-how, so it does a job well with less prompting: build slides from a brief, plan a trip from your inbox, or track competitors.
See how people turn ideas into real businesses on Buildly.
Tutr is a marketplace for tutors, built entirely on Buildly: find a tutor, book a lesson and pay in one place. It’s already taking bookings.
That’s it for this month. Go build something good.
You’re getting this because you signed up for updates.

values.preheaderText: Five updates this month, plus a customer story.
